items.title: Hasbro (HAS) Partners To Develop Playocity In Jeddah
items.summary: Hasbro (NasdaqGS:HAS) has partnered with BAAN Holding Group to create Playocity, a large family entertainment destination in Jeddah. The Playocity project will be located at Westfield Center in Jeddah, expanding Hasbro branded attractions into Saudi Arabia. Management plans to feature Hasbro characters and entertainment brands within Playocity to build out a broader family-focused venue. items.title: McDonald's Takes a Chance by Bringing Back Monopoly: Can It Change Its Fortunes Passing Go or Is the Stock Going to Remain in Jail?
items.summary: McDonald’s Corp. (NYSE:MCD) is bringing back its Monopoly promotion with a $1 million cash prize as the fast-food giant looks to reignite momentum during a rough phase for its stock, which is down more than 17% so far this year. Goes Bigger on Monopoly Monopoly, based on the iconic board game from Hasbro Inc. (NASDAQ:HAS), returns Oct. 6, with customers peeling physical game pieces from eligible McDonald’s packaging and scanning them in the app to claim prizes or enter the game’s bigger contests
